title: Retired live lift: owner-epoch reorg liveness needs a failpoint-enabled TiDB

payload.intended_c3_oracle: a forced same-second owner retire/re-become during active ADD INDEX must show stale result acceptance causing rollback, stuck DDL, or incorrect reorg progress
evidence: tc-tidb-0 is a single TiDB replica using hub.pingcap.net/pingcap/tidb/images/tidb-server:master
GET and PUT on /fail/github.com/pingcap/tidb/... returned HTTP 404 while /status returned 200
pkg/server/http_status.go registers /fail only behind compile-time failpoint enableTestAPI; the current ordinary master image has not registered that handler
a pod restart cannot make the same TiDB retire and re-become within one wall-clock second, so it cannot test the ownerTS collision
payload.next_reopen: Use a failpoint-enabled TiDB image with enableTestAPI registered, or a purpose-built integration harness that can force beforeCreateLocalBackend plus ownerResignAfterDispatchLoopCheck while observing active reorg result acceptance. Do not infer C3 from the root-boundary token collision alone.

provenance.source: testbed 8220955 capability check plus current TiDB server source

evidence.oracle: The live lift is valid only if the exact owner-reentry fault can be injected during an active reorg; an unavailable fault point is INVALID rather than GREEN.

observed.failpoint_endpoint: 404 Not Found for both known failpoints

lessons.severity_gate: A source-level C3 consequence is not enough. The fault schedule and the user-visible liveness oracle must both be executable before a C2/root-boundary candidate enters the serious-bug queue.
lessons.negative_capability: Ordinary tidb-server:master cannot be converted into a dynamic-failpoint target by runtime config because the /fail route itself is guarded by compile-time failpoint instrumentation.
lessons.next_step: Return to C3_DIRECT DDL sourcing instead of retrying pod restarts or timing races on this testbed.
